blocks.text: Cebuano Kenny Roger Rocacurva delivered when it mattered most, providing the crucial scoring punch that complemented fellow Cebuano Nic Cabañero as Biñan Tatak Gel stunned defending champion Quezon Province, 83-74, in Game 1 of the South Division Finals of the SportsPlus MPBL (Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League) 2026 Season on Tuesday night at the Ynares Sports Arena in Pasig....
